name: course-package-tester
description: Local preflight tester for SCORM and web course packages.
author: Staros Labs

scripts.package:windows: electron-packager . "Course Package Tester" --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=dist/desktop --overwrite --prune=true --ignore="^/dist($|/)" --ignore="^/.git($|/)" --ignore="^/.github($|/)" --executable-name=CoursePackageTester && npm run prepare:windows-handoff
scripts.package:windows:signed: npm run package:windows && npm run sign:windows && npm run package:windows:zip:existing
scripts.package:windows:zip: npm run package:windows && npm run package:windows:zip:existing
